title: The speed of the 'bullet' in the merging galaxy cluster 1E0657-56

evidence.locator: Sect. I: the lensing data are fitted with two spherically symmetric NFW halos. Sect. V.1: an offset from a central collision introduces more axial asymmetry than is observed in the cones of the bow shock and the cold front; the system should be close to a central merger in the plane of the sky, and the paper's simulations are exactly central, the merger axis in the plane of the sky.
